mentions.name: Site Tools Box
mentions.description: A free webmaster directory combining built-in tools such as DNS and IP lookups and domain appraisals with a hand-picked list of resources for SEOs and developers. Includes a 'Spotlight Gallery' feature that showcases the best tools each week, built from scratch in vanilla PHP.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on a free webmaster directory called Site Tools Box (https://sitetoolsbox.com). It combines a set of built-in tools (DNS, IP, domain appraisals) with a hand-picked list of resources for SEOs and devs. Just launched a 'Spotlight Gallery' feature recently to showcase the best tools each week.
